content.text: /ext:medcp Among drug classes associated with electrolyte disturbances in the KG, which ones most often precede abnormal electrolytes in our data within 30 days?

I’ll treat “precede” as a drug exposure starting 1–30 days before an abnormal electrolyte lab, and count patient-level drug-class/lab pairs. First I’ll inspect the OMOP lab/drug vocabulary enough to make the cohort reproducible.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 50 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND ((m.range_low IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number < m.range_low) OR (m.range_high IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number > m.range_high)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_n
FROM omop.measurement m
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=m.measurement_concept_id
WHERE m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
  AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%potassium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sodium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%calcium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%magnesium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%phosphate%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chloride%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%bicarbonate%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%carbon dioxide%')
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id
ORDER BY n DESC

I don’t see a separate KG resource exposed through the selected clinical extension, so I’ll operationalize the KG set as common electrolyte-disturbance drug classes and map them through OMOP drug-class ancestors. Next I’ll count abnormal serum/plasma electrolyte measurements within 30 days after class exposure.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 200 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Drug'
  AND (
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%diuretic%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitor%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ace inhibitor%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%angiotensin receptor blocker%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%proton pump inhibitor%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ssri%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%laxative%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%glucocorticoid%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%corticosteroid%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%beta-2 adrenergic agonist%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%beta 2 adrenergic agonist%' OR
    LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%calcineurin inhibitor%'
  )
ORDER BY vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, concept_name

WITH drug_classes AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (21601461, 'Diuretics'),
        (21601783, 'ACE inhibitors'),
        (21601801, 'ACE inhibitors combinations'),
        (21601833, 'ARBs + diuretics'),
        (21600095, 'Proton pump inhibitors'),
        (21604709, 'SSRIs'),
        (21600537, 'Contact laxatives'),
        (21600565, 'Osmotic laxatives'),
        (21600554, 'Bulk-forming laxatives'),
        (21602722, 'Systemic corticosteroids'),
        (21603923, 'Calcineurin inhibitors')
    ) AS v(class_concept_id, class_name)
), abnormal_labs AS (
    SELECT m.measurement_id, m.person_id, m.measurement_date,
           CASE m.measurement_concept_id
             WHEN 3023103 THEN 'Potassium'
             WHEN 3019550 THEN 'Sodium'
             WHEN 3014576 THEN 'Chloride'
             WHEN 3015632 THEN 'Carbon dioxide/bicarbonate'
             WHEN 3006906 THEN 'Calcium'
             WHEN 3001420 THEN 'Magnesium'
             WHEN 3011904 THEN 'Phosphate'
           END AS electrolyte
    FROM omop.measurement m
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3023103,3019550,3014576,3015632,3006906,3001420,3011904)
      AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
      AND ((m.range_low IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number < m.range_low)
        OR (m.range_high IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number > m.range_high))
)
SELECT TOP 25 dc.class_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT al.measurement_id) AS abnormal_electrolyte_events_with_prior_class,
       COUNT(DISTINCT al.person_id) AS patients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT de.drug_exposure_id) AS prior_drug_exposures
FROM drug_classes dc
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = dc.class_concept_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN abnormal_labs al ON al.person_id = de.person_id
                    AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, al.measurement_date)
                    AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < al.measurement_date
GROUP BY dc.class_name
ORDER BY abnormal_electrolyte_events_with_prior_class DESC;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH drug_classes AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (21601461, 'Diuretics'),
        (21601783, 'ACE inhibitors'),
        (21601801, 'ACE inhibitors combinations'),
        (21601833, 'ARBs + diuretics'),
        (21600095, 'Proton pump inhibitors'),
        (21604709, 'SSRIs'),
        (21600537, 'Contact laxatives'),
        (21600565, 'Osmotic laxatives'),
        (21600554, 'Bulk-forming laxatives'),
        (21602722, 'Systemic corticosteroids'),
        (21603923, 'Calcineurin inhibitors')
    ) AS v(class_concept_id, class_name)
), abnormal_labs AS (
    SELECT m.measurement_id, m.person_id, m.measurement_date,
           CASE m.measurement_concept_id
             WHEN 3023103 THEN 'Potassium'
             WHEN 3019550 THEN 'Sodium'
             WHEN 3014576 THEN 'Chloride'
             WHEN 3015632 THEN 'CO2/bicarbonate'
             WHEN 3006906 THEN 'Calcium'
             WHEN 3001420 THEN 'Magnesium'
             WHEN 3011904 THEN 'Phosphate'
           END AS electrolyte,
           CASE WHEN m.range_low IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number < m.range_low THEN 'low'
                WHEN m.range_high IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number > m.range_high THEN 'high'
                ELSE 'abnormal' END AS direction
    FROM omop.measurement m
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3023103,3019550,3014576,3015632,3006906,3001420,3011904)
      AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
      AND ((m.range_low IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number < m.range_low)
        OR (m.range_high IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number > m.range_high))
), class_lab AS (
    SELECT dc.class_name, al.electrolyte, al.direction,
           COUNT(DISTINCT al.measurement_id) AS events,
           COUNT(DISTINCT al.person_id) AS patients
    FROM drug_classes dc
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = dc.class_concept_id
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
    JOIN abnormal_labs al ON al.person_id = de.person_id
                        AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, al.measurement_date)
                        AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < al.measurement_date
    GROUP BY dc.class_name, al.electrolyte, al.direction
)
SELECT TOP 30 class_name, electrolyte, direction, events, patients
FROM class_lab
ORDER BY events DESC;

Using OMOP drug-class ancestors and abnormal serum/plasma electrolyte labs with `value_as_number` outside `range_low/range_high`, the drug classes most often starting 1–30 days before an abnormal electrolyte were:

Most common class–electrolyte signals were high potassium after calcineurin inhibitors, systemic corticosteroids, PPIs, osmotic laxatives, and diuretics. Counts are not mutually exclusive: the same abnormal lab can be counted under multiple prior drug classes if exposures overlapped within 30 days.
